# Responsive Reference

Source: PGraeff/rules/responsive.md (STRONG_HEURISTIC)

## Purpose
Fluid layouts, breakpoints, and responsive transformations.

## Guidelines
1. Determine responsive transformations explicitly (stacking, collapsing, hiding) rather than merely shrinking elements.
2. Use relative units (rem, %, flex/grid fractions) and fluid typography where appropriate.
3. Test layouts across mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1280px+) breakpoints.
